name: smoke
about: Proves the router against real Orca on harmless work: two workers at once, a heartbeat, a question, a failure with a retry, a script step, a gate. Workers write only under {OUT}. Start it with OUT=<an empty scratch directory>.

steps.run: echo "VAR ANSWER=$(sed -n 's/^VERDICT: *//p' {OUT}/ask.txt)"; echo OK recorded the answer

steps.title: smoke gate: the lines below are what the coordinator would read
show: echo OK the answer recorded by the script step: {ANSWER}
